notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend exists and no hardware was run. Target: the easy registered variant ur5ePegInHoleGymEnv_easy-v0 (mujoco_sim/__init__.py:10-55), whose XYZGripperCloseEnv narrows the 7-element base Box (ur5e_pick_gym_connector.py:234-236) to x, y, z in [-1, 1] (wrappers.py:134-138) and whose CustomObsWrapper plus FlattenObservation publish the 27-value flattened observation (6+6+3+3+3+6; mujoco_sim/__init__.py:27-42). MuJoCo 3.2.5, gymnasium 1.0.0, glfw and PyOpenGL are not importable where the gate ran, so the fake backend is the package's own pure-Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py); it was never compared with the upstream environment and the sim backend (gymnasium.make, which also needs a display and the SpacemouseIntervention input device) was not run. The fake reproduces the full observation size, the 1000-step truncation (config.py:15) and the sparse -1 reward, but not the MuJoCo dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or the peg-in-hole success termination; every start value and step scale in fake.py is marked # placeholder. Five warnings are expected of every Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values, seed twice). Only catalogue cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
